description: This file defines a Java record 'EmiAdjustment' that encapsulates data related to EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) adjustments, including financial figures and related repayment periods. It provides methods for calculation and comparison of EMI adjustments within the loan product calculation context.

methods.name: shouldBeAdjusted
methods.description: Determines whether the EMI adjustment should be applied based on the related repayment periods and the magnitude of the EMI difference.

methods.name: adjustment
methods.description: Calculates the adjustment amount by dividing the EMI difference by the number of related periods minus any uncountable periods.

methods.name: adjustedEmi
methods.description: Returns the new EMI amount after applying the adjustment.

methods.name: hasLessEmiDifference
methods.description: Compares the current EMI adjustment with a previous one to check if it has a smaller difference.

methods.name: hasUncountablePeriods
methods.description: Checks if there are any uncountable periods involved in the adjustment.
